noInherit.description: If true, the annotation is not inherited by mixins.

possibles.description:
Expression for calculating possible values. For field and member method parameters the
scope is instance of the C3 type. For constants and static method parameters the scope is the C3 type.

secret.description: If true, the value is a secret.

title: Annotation for customizing value types in fields and function params.
